description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 7 came out on 6 November 2026, introduced with Psyduck, which stumbles on treasure while lost in thought. As in the earlier volumes, every card is a holo, four to a pack, and each Pokémon comes in several finishes of the same art, among them a pattern of its Energy type, a Master Ball pattern and the Gem Pack logo. Many of its cards are Trainer's Pokémon, trainers appearing with their partner Pokémon. Every Pokémon in the volume also has an art illustration card, and Misty's Psyduck has a new one: on a sunny beach, Psyduck lies back in a deck chair holding a beach ball high, as if calling Misty over to play.

This volume holds only Pokémon: 28 of them, among them Team Rocket's Raticate, Meowth, Weezing, Murkrow, Wobbuffet, Houndoom, Orbeetle and Spidops, Misty's Psyduck and Lapras, Ethan's Typhlosion, Steven's Beldum, Cynthia's Roserade, N's Zorua, Lillie's Ribombee, Arven's Greedent, Hop's Wooloo, Marnie's Morpeko and Iono's Kilowattrel, each in seven versions. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Team Rocket's Raticate to 28 for Hydrapple, and the last two for the version, out of 07.
